about: Curated facts and hooks. One entry per fact. A fact is only asked if its recognition is at least the game threshold (3 = known worldwide, 2 = known to a well-read player, 1 = known mostly inside the country). `kind` groups facts whose answers can stand in as wrong options for each other; `wrong` lists hand-picked wrong options for one-off questions; `sharedWith` lists other countries the answer is also true for; `group` marks answers too close to offer against each other; `hook` marks the memorable ones; `unsure` marks facts worth double-checking. `avoid` lists answers that are never offered as wrong options for a fact because they are also arguably true (a second national sport, another of the country's top exports). People (category person) are only asked at recognition 3.
